title: Keeping a word you have run into
description: The word goes into a personal deck together with the context that made it stand out.

blocks.text: Later it is hard to recall not just the word but the situation it was heard in.

quote.text: When I first started learning Japanese, one of my biggest problems was that I’d hear new words or phrases being spoken when I was going about my day but before I could write them down, I’d forget them.

blocks.text: Save a draft quickly, then fill in the meaning, an example and the audio. Before the review, check that the question and the answer fit your own goal.
Speed of capture should not do away with checking the content.
